title.narrative: Towards the Realisation of Climate Change Bill in Kenya

description.narrative:
The Kenya Climate Change Working Group (KCCWG) plans to organise a key stakeholders' workshop and two sets of meetings whose overarching goal is to develop and achieve a climate change bill in Kenya.
The proposed project 'Towards Realization of the Climate Change Bill in Kenya' is aimed at achieving three key outcomes. First; a parliamentarians and KCCWG Climate Change Bill Team Set Up. Secondly; a revised edition of the climate change bill produced and Finally; a specific roadmap to achieve the Climate Change Bill is drawn and implemented.
To realise these outcomes, the KCCWG plans to undertake the following activities: - 1. To form a Parliamentarian and KCCWG Team that will be involved in organising a stakeholders' workshop on Climate Change and organising Task Force Meetings. 2. To engage a KCCWG technical persons to provide specific inputs to the current draft bill on climate change. 3. To Produce relevant Information Education and Communication (IEC) materials for creating awareness on the climate change bill. 4. Organise One meeting between KCCWG Technical Persons and the Bill Drafters
